title: Full-Body Strength & Weight Loss Foundation

items.name: Cat-Cow
items.cues: Move slowly and deliberately, synchronizing breath with movement. Inhale on cow, exhale on cat. Focus on spinal articulation.

items.name: Bird Dog
items.cues: Extend opposite arm and leg simultaneously, maintaining neutral spine. Hold each rep for 1 second at full extension. Keep core engaged throughout.

items.name: Biceps Wall Stretch
items.cues: Stand sideways to wall, place forearm against wall with palm up. Gently rotate body away. Hold and breathe steadily.

items.name: Burpees
items.cues: Start standing, drop to plank position with controlled movement. Lower chest to ground, push back explosively to standing. Maintain core stability throughout. Breathe out on exertion.

items.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
items.cues: Rear foot elevated on a low surface. Front knee tracks over toes as you lower. Keep torso upright and chest proud. Drive through front heel to return to start.

items.name: Bear Crawl
items.cues: Start in plank position with hips slightly elevated. Move opposite arm and leg forward in controlled fashion. Keep core tight and hips level. This is a full-body strengthener.

items.name: Ab Scissors
items.cues: Lie on back, legs extended and slightly elevated. Cross legs in a scissoring motion, alternating which leg is on top. Keep lower back pressed to floor throughout.

items.name: Bench Dip
items.cues: Hands on elevated surface behind you, feet on ground. Lower body by bending elbows to approximately 90 degrees. Keep elbows tucked close to body. Drive through palms to return.

items.name: Calf Stretch
items.cues: Step forward into a lunge position, keeping rear heel on ground and leg straight. Feel stretch in rear calf. Hold and breathe deeply. Switch sides.

items.name: Butterfly Sit-Up
items.cues: Sit with soles of feet together, knees out to sides. Gently lean back, then return to upright. Focus on slow, controlled movement. Excellent for hip and spinal mobility.

items.name: Cat-Cow
items.cues: Move slowly and mindfully. Use this to decompress the spine after the intense workout. Synchronize with breath for relaxation.

rationale: User is returning from extended rest (999 days), so workout emphasizes moderate intensity (RPE 6-7) with bodyweight exercises to re-establish baseline strength and work capacity without overloading joints.

Weight loss goal benefits from high-calorie compound movements (burpees, bear crawls, Bulgarian split squats) combined with controlled strength work to preserve muscle while creating metabolic demand.

No equipment constraints means full reliance on bodyweight exercises; progression will come from reps, sets, and movement quality rather than external load, ideal for rebuilding confidence and movement patterns.
